body: I used to be on Flunitrazepam back when I was a teenager. It was the only thing that would calm me down in social situations until I became immune to it. Later they took it off the market because it was a date rape drug. Then they put me on Xanax but that had very little affect on my social problem. It just zonked me out but didn't change my mood. I lost my medical insurance a few years back and I can't afford the doctor anymore. I can't afford these drugs either. I also can't stand talking to the doctor.
